$comment: Seed speech definition (Gate I, Phase 47, phonics age 7). A shared instruction stem (C21 variant 'instruction', the player's 'Read it to me'; owner decision D-1): the on-screen instruction without the words the child must read. ID by the admin convention instruction-<first words>. 'Read' is a heteronym, so the SSML says it as 'reed' with <sub>, as instruction-read-the-word-then-tap does. Loaded as a DRAFT by scripts/seed_content.py, then previewed, played to the end and approved in the admin app.
